justification: D-018c (with D-009#1, #5): errors are reported where they occur, without legacy's "return: " prefixes and, in code legacy runs on its loop evaluator, with the canonical wording. The class rule classifies with the entry's own program through vm_policies.classify: same stdout, one diagnostic each, the VM position equal to the failing node derived independently from the CP10 AST (exact evaluation of constant operands), legacy's position the reported statement, loop or call site, and every message field equal to legacy's or, where legacy's loop wording omits it, to the constant the source gives. No D-018a class: numbers are never approved by policy (review round 2).
